title: Hal R NDE 4379
content: I sustained a major brain injury, broken back and rib cage from an accident between a bicycle and moving van. I came to in the ambulance. I passed out in the emergency room. What actually happened was that my lungs collapsed and I stopped breathing. After awakening in the hospital, three days later, I was groggy, not knowing where I was or what happened. After a while, I started to piece together what happened. I could remember bicycling, waking up in the ambulance, and then going blank. What I remembered next was moving down a 'hallway' but not really a hallway. I was moving by 'scenes with remembrance' and thinking, 'I remember that. I should go in there,' but I didn't. There were many of these 'scenes', one after another, but I did not go into them because I was coerced to keep going. I came to the end of this 'hallway' it opened up to an infinitely large space. In this space, there were an infinite amount of what I could describe would be souls communicating with each other simultaneously. I was in awe at the magnitude of thoughts being communicated between these souls. I could focus in on one area and pick out the 'conversation'. What I really mean was that thoughts were directly spread between these souls, no words were spoken. I did not see anything, including any light or darkness. I could just sense these communications and I was overwhelmed, not by fear but by joy. Then I was forced (how, I don't know) to turn back. I traveled back down the 'hallway,' past the same scenes I came in seeing. I remember that I really wanted to go into this one scene to greet them, but I was forced on. The hallway faded out and that was the end. I don't remember who those entities were.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Moving down a 'hallway' but not really a hallway; moving past 'scenes with remembrance'.

arrival.other_being_detail: An infinite amount of what he could describe as souls, communicating simultaneously; he could focus and pick out a 'conversation' (thoughts directly spread, no words). He did not know who the entities were.

environment.environment_other_detail: An 'infinitely large space' with sensed simultaneous communications; he did not see anything (no light or darkness).

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Forced to turn back; traveled back down the 'hallway' until it faded out.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Accident between a bicycle and moving van; lungs collapsed and he stopped breathing.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Movement past multiple 'scenes with remembrance' while being coerced to keep going; arrival into an infinitely large space with many souls communicating; then forced return back down the hallway.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: He reports not seeing anything at all, including any light or darkness, while still sensing an infinitely large space and telepathic communications among many souls; 'scenes with remembrance' along a hallway-like passage.
